title: Extreme points in quotients of Hardy spaces
summary: In the Hardy spaces $H^1$ and $H^\infty$, there are neat and well-known characterizations of the extreme points of the unit ball. We obtain counterparts of these classical theorems when $H^1$ (resp., $H^\infty$) gets replaced by the quotient space $H^1/E$ (resp., $H^\infty/E$), under certain assumptions on the subspace $E$. In the $H^1$ setting, we also treat the case where the underlying space is taken to be the kernel of a Toeplitz operator.
